title: stt.asrEngine node config (mandatory)
description: Selects the ASR engine model. `modelSlug` references an AiModel row with taskType AUTOMATIC_SPEECH_RECOGNITION (apps/stt/src/stt/pipeline/dto.py ModelTaskType) by slug, no FK — mirrors AsrPipeline.configYaml's `models.asr` convention exactly, since this node's config is exactly what the compiler (TASK-724 Task 4) copies into that YAML key. Bounded elsewhere, not by this schema: TenantSttConfig (tenant's allowed engines/fallback), IEntitlementsService quota/feature gates, and language_modes.py's `engine_supports_mode` compatibility check against an upstream stt.languageDetection node — none of that is schema-expressible (repository/entitlement I/O), so it lives in the impure validator layer, consistent with N-2's promptTemplateId precedent (TASK-720 palette.md).
